faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Can AI really unblur a photo?
faq.a1: Yes! Modern AI models can reconstruct lost details in blurry images caused by motion, focus issues, or low resolution. Our tool uses deep learning to intelligently restore clarity.
faq.q2: Is this tool free to use?
faq.a2: Yes, you can unblur images online for free with no registration required. Just upload your photo and get results instantly.
faq.q3: How do I unblur an image online?
faq.a3: Simply upload your blurry image using the button above. Our AI processes it in seconds and returns a sharper, clearer version—no software download needed.
faq.q4: Can it fix blurry faces in photos?
faq.a4: Absolutely. Our AI is optimized to detect and enhance facial features in out-of-focus or motion-blurred portraits, making eyes, skin, and expressions clearer.
faq.q5: Does it work on text or documents?
faq.a5: Yes! It can sharpen blurry text in screenshots, receipts, scanned PDFs, and ID cards, making the content readable again.
faq.q6: What types of blur can this tool fix?
faq.a6: It handles motion blur, camera shake, out-of-focus blur, and low-resolution softness. However, extreme blur with no recoverable detail may have limited improvement.
faq.a7: Yes. All images are processed securely and automatically deleted from our servers within minutes. We don't store or share your files.
faq.q8: Can I use this on mobile phones?
faq.a8: Yes! The tool works on any device—iPhone, Android, tablet, or desktop. No app install required; just open the website in your browser.
faq.q9: How to unblur an image on iPhone or Android?
faq.a9: Simply open our website in your mobile browser - no app download needed! Tap 'Upload Image', select your photo from your gallery, and our AI will unblur it in seconds. Works perfectly on iPhone, Samsung, and all Android devices.
faq.q10: What's the difference between unblur and sharpen?
faq.a10: Unblur specifically targets and fixes blur caused by motion, focus issues, or camera shake by reconstructing lost details. Sharpen enhances edge contrast to make images appear crisper. Our AI unblur tool does both - it removes blur AND enhances sharpness for the best results.
